function_question: How does nature grip soft or fragile things gently?

opening.text: There was a boy called Lucas, 14, whose uncle ran a fruit farm, and who spent every summer fixing machines in the barn.
Lucas watched the farm's new picking robot zip along the rows, grabbing tomato after tomato.
His uncle held up a crate of squashed, bruised tomatoes. "The robot is fast, but it grips like a vice," he said. "We can't sell these. Can you make its hands gentler?"

card.goal: Hold a tomato without a single bruise

guide.brief: I'm Popi, your story guide. The farm's picking robot grips so hard that it bruises the tomatoes, and Lucas has to make its hands gentle. Can you help him? Let's start!
guide.your_idea: Some inventors already picture a gentle robot hand. Do you?
guide.nature_clues: Nature grabs slippery, soft and fragile things every day. Tap each card to meet four gentle grippers!
guide.design_secret: Here's the secret all four heroes share…
guide.skill: Same squeeze, different fingers. Which gripper will leave the shallowest dent? Predict first, then measure!
guide.sketch: Draw your gripper open and closed, with arrows showing where the force spreads out.
guide.build_and_test: Test your gripper on all 5 objects: tennis ball, egg, tomato, grape and crisp. How many does it hold without damage?
guide.retry_tip: Don't squeeze harder, spread the force! Change ONE thing and test all 5 objects again.
guide.ending: And ever since then, the farm's robot picks tomatoes as gently as an octopus, and Lucas is already building his next soft robot!

quick_check.question: A hard robot finger presses with 5 N on 1 cm² of tomato. A soft finger presses with the same 5 N spread over 5 cm². What happens to the pressure?
quick_check.right: Right! Pressure = force ÷ area. 5 ÷ 1 = 5 N per cm², but 5 ÷ 5 = 1 N per cm². Same force, five times gentler!
quick_check.wrong: Not quite. Pressure is force divided by area. What is 5 ÷ 5?

clue_cards.name: Octopus
clue_cards.trick: Boneless arms with around 2,000 suckers in total.
clue_cards.does: It wraps around any shape and holds it with gentle suction all along the arm.

clue_cards.name: Fish fin
clue_cards.trick: Push on its side and the fin curls towards your push.
clue_cards.does: It hugs whatever presses on it, spreading the force.

clue_cards.name: Elephant trunk
clue_cards.trick: Tens of thousands of muscle bundles and no bones.
clue_cards.does: It curls around a heavy log or plucks a single blade of grass.

clue_cards.name: Venus flytrap
clue_cards.trick: It stores energy in its curved leaf, then flips it inside out.
clue_cards.does: It snaps shut in about a tenth of a second, with no muscles at all.

predict.prompt: Spreads the force, or pinches in one spot? Predict first!

items.label: Two hard chopsticks squeezing a grape
An octopus arm wrapped around a shell
A soft glove cupping an egg

predict.explain: A hard, narrow grip puts all the force on tiny spots, so the pressure there is huge. A soft grip that wraps around touches a much bigger area, so each spot feels only a gentle press.

lab.title: The playdough bruise lab
lab.predict: Four grippers squeeze identical playdough balls, each closed by the same rubber band. Which will leave the shallowest dent?

tool.name: Mind map
tool.intro: You already know how a mind map grows out from the centre. Today you'll use all 5 pieces to map every need of a real robot, like a systems engineer.

parts.name: Centre
parts.what: Write the big question in the middle.
parts.example: ⛑️ "A better bike helmet" goes in the middle.
parts.starter: In the middle I write "gentle gripper", because the robot must…

parts.name: Branches
parts.what: Draw lines out to the main topics.
parts.example: ⛑️ Branches: protect, comfy, light, easy to see.
parts.starter: My branches are grip, gentleness, speed and…

parts.name: Twigs
parts.what: Add smaller ideas to each branch.
parts.example: ⛑️ On "protect": a foam liner and a hard shell.
parts.starter: On the "gentleness" branch I add the fin ray and…

parts.name: Pictures
parts.what: Add quick doodles so ideas pop out.

parts.name: Links
parts.what: Join ideas on different branches with a line.
parts.example: ⛑️ Link "foam liner" to "comfy": one part does two jobs!
parts.starter: I link two branches together, like the octopus suckers and…

sketch_checklist: I drew my gripper open and closed.
I labelled the soft parts and where they touch the fruit.
I showed with arrows how the force spreads out.

test.measure: objects held without damage out of 5

reflection.question: Which nature trick helped your gripper the most?
